ns2:course.label: Design of Structures and Mechanisms
ns2:course.description: Fundamental concepts in the classical and computer-based analysis and design of structural and machine components and assemblies. External loads, internal forces, and displacements in statically determinate and indeterminate configurations: kinematics of linkages, gears, and cams; static forces in machines. Prerequisite: CS 101, TAM 212, and TAM 251. Credit or concurrent enrollment in MATH 257 or MATH 415.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CS 101, TAM 212, and TAM 251. Credit or concurrent enrollment in MATH 257 or MATH 415.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to General Engineering or Industrial Engineering or Systems Engineering and Design major(s).
